name: Scam Sniffer
purpose: Assess whether a website domain is likely a scam using domain age, HTTPS accessibility, and web search evidence, with escalation only for borderline cases.
persona: A wary, clipped inspector who gives a cautious verdict.

domain.description: Website domain to inspect, without protocol, like example.com

parallel.note: Look up domain registration data via RDAP
Check whether the site loads over HTTPS

args.query: {{inputs.domain}} scam review OR scam OR fraud OR legit

steps.note: Extract registration age and expiry signals from RDAP
Classify search snippets into complaint/support signals
Apply a fixed rubric and decide whether to escalate

inputs.research_question: Investigate whether the website domain {{inputs.domain}} is a scam or fraudulent. Focus on customer complaints, ownership clues, reputation, security signals, and any concrete evidence of legitimacy or deception.
inputs.additional_context: Use public web sources only. Summarize the strongest evidence for and against scam risk, and note any red flags or trust signals.

steps.note: Use a paid web research agent only for borderline cases
Create spoken verdict and markdown report

forged_limbs.name: extract_rdap_age
forged_limbs.description: Extract RDAP creation and expiration signals and estimate domain age in days from RDAP JSON or fallback text.

forged_limbs.name: extract_search_signals
forged_limbs.description: Count negative, positive, and neutral mentions in search results and keep short notes.

results.title: Is example.com a scam?
results.content: Several users call it a scam and fake

forged_limbs.name: score_scam_risk
forged_limbs.description: Fixed rubric for scam likelihood and borderline escalation.

reasons: Domain age is older than 6 months
HTTPS probe failed or site unreachable

forged_limbs.name: compose_scam_report
forged_limbs.description: Compose a short spoken verdict and a detailed markdown report from the scored evidence and optional escalation result.

expect.speech: example.com looks likely not scam with a risk score of 0 out of 100. The main checks look better than not. The domain is about 2 years old, HTTPS works, and search results do not raise strong alarm.
expect.report:

## Verdict

- **Classification:** likely not scam
- **Risk score:** 0/100
- **Domain age:** about 2 years old
- **HTTPS:** works
- **Search summary:** 0 negative, 2 positive, 1 neutral search results

## Reasons
- A
- B

expect.speech: x.com looks borderline with a risk score of 55 out of 100. The domain is about 14 days old, HTTPS failed, and search results are mixed. I could not complete the paid follow-up.

safety.notes: This is a defensive website-risk assessment workflow using domain age, HTTPS, and public web signals with optional escalation for borderline cases.

voice.first_message: I’m checking the domain now. I’ll judge its age, HTTPS, and search reputation.
